title: VendPoint Settling Par for Corbett-Placed Substitutes — Customer Par Change Terms
content:
## Par changes on a substitute's selection

The customer may ask to add items, change par quantities or remove items at any time on an active machine, except that a par change the customer asks for on the selection of a Corbett-placed substitute in its first three months, and only such a change, is set at the substitute settling par figured below rather than at a par the customer names; changes take effect at the next restock visit.

The newest item is the item whose add entry on the machine's selection history carries the highest planogram request reference (Corbett issues these references in sequence); it is a Corbett-placed substitute when that add entry is from Corbett and the item carries, on the customer's agreement, a contract price line written as a Corbett-approved substitute for a discontinued item, and its first three months are the three months after the date of that add entry; the retired item it replaces is the item of the customer's contract price line written as a removal carrying the highest change reference (removal lines are change lines, whose references Corbett issues in sequence).

The par change is the customer's own act: the customer records a par change entry from the customer on that selection, dated the day of the request, at the settling par, and it counts toward the included changes like any other change the customer asks for.

A par change on the selection of a Corbett-placed substitute is fixed only after the substitute stands in the retired item's selection as an add entry from Corbett.

Whole months between two dates are counted as the difference in calendar months, less one when the day of the month of the later date is before the day of the month of the earlier date; a record counts in a stated number of months ending today when fewer whole months than that number, counted this way, separate its date from today.

These terms belong to the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program; the substitute and retired item lines are those of the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement.

### Which par a requested change takes

| Par change asked for by the customer | Par recorded |
|---|---|
| On the selection of a Corbett-placed substitute, in its first three months | The substitute settling par |
| Any other par change | The par the customer names |

Hypothetical dates: for a substitute add entry dated 10 August, a request on 9 November is two whole months after it and inside the first three months; a request on 10 November is three whole months after it and outside them.

## The par change entry: `set_substitute_selection_par_5d8137ae`

**Capability.** The tool records a par change asked for by the customer on one selection of a VendPoint machine: a new selection history entry sets the par quantity of the named selection and item to the value given, marked as a customer change of type par change, dated today and carrying the next planogram request reference in sequence, one above the highest planogram request reference on record. The item's product category and special-item flag are carried over from the latest existing entry of that selection and item.

**Invocation.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs `set_substitute_selection_par_5d8137ae`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `vending_machine_id` | The reference number of the VendPoint machine placement whose selection is changed, as returned by the machine lookup |
| `slot_label` | The label of the selection (door, coil or bay) exactly as it appears on the machine's selection history entries, copied character for character |
| `sku` | The Corbett item number held in that selection exactly as it appears on the machine's selection history entries, copied character for character |
| `par_qty` | The new par quantity of the selection: a whole number of units, zero or more, with no decimal part |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` with the text `par_changed`, `vending_slot_id` (the new selection history entry), `vending_machine_id`, `slot_label` and `sku` echoed back, `par_qty` (the new par as an integer number of units), `change_reference` (the planogram request reference issued, letters VPC, a hyphen and six digits) and `effective_date` (the date of the entry in YYYY-MM-DD form).
